matched_null.alpha_control: each null fold uses the real movement arm's alpha selected by inner leave-one-game-out on that same outer training set; no held-out labels/features enter alpha choice
matched_null.permutation: each of 26 movement values/missing values independently permuted across outer-training rows; held-out game movement stays intact
matched_null.seed_schedule: base seed 20261022; replicate/fold seed = base + replicate_index * 10 + sorted_game_index, indices zero-based

metadata.evaluation: outer leave-one-game-out; alpha selected independently within each outer training set by inner leave-one-game-out
metadata.selection_metric: pooled inner-LOO Brier score; minimum selected, ties resolve to first alpha in the listed ascending grid
